Company Description

WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.

Job Description

• The Financial Consolidation Manager oversees the global month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial consolidation processes for a multinational organization.
• This role ensures high-quality consolidated financial statements, adherence to applicable accounting standards (e.g., U.S. GAAP and Local GAAP), and timely delivery of internal and external reporting.
• The position acts as a key liaison between corporate headquarters and international subsidiaries, driving consistency, compliance, and process improvement across global finance operations.
• The role is responsible for managing financial close, general ledger, balance sheet, and reporting processes in compliance with U.S. GAAP, company policies, and regulatory requirements.
• This position will be responsible for performing and reviewing end-to-end Record to Report (R2R) processes to ensure compliance with the accounting standards (U.S. GAAP), internal controls, and company policies, while driving process improvement and operational excellence across all R2R functions.
• Execute monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities to ensure timely and accurate financial results.
• Lead and ensure the accuracy of the end-to-end global consolidation process for all international entities, including elimination entries, foreign currency translation, and intercompany reconciliations.
• Serve as administrator for SAP Business Planning and Consolidation (BPC) system.
• Serve as administrator for certain SAP FI-CO functionalities.
• Review subsidiary submissions for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with policies.
• Manage consolidation adjustments, non-controlling interests, joint ventures, and acquisition-related consolidation activities.
• Prepare consolidated financial statements and management reporting packages for senior leadership, including cash flow statements.
• Analyze trial balances and financial results in local and reporting currencies; investigate variances and resolve discrepancies.
• Manage and validate foreign currency revaluation.
• Prepare local statutory, governmental, and other external reports.
• Maintain accounting records in accordance with U.S. GAAP, corporate policies, and the chart of accounts.
• Drive consistency in financial processes across regions.
• Ensure strong internal controls over financial reporting.
• Act as the primary point of contact for regional finance teams regarding consolidation and reporting matters, including local statutory reporting requirements.
• Collaborate with Tax, Treasury, FP&A, and Corporate Accounting on cross-functional financial matters.
• Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, and adjustments.
• Perform and approve balance sheet and general ledger reconciliations; ensure completeness, accuracy, and timely resolution of open items.
• Prepare monthly balance sheet review materials and communicate key findings to management.
• Prepare schedules and record prepayments and amortization, including intangible assets and debt issuance costs.
• Collaborate with Treasury on daily and monthly cash reporting, including payment discounts.
• Support tax accounting processes, including deferred taxes, local taxes, provisions, and adjustments.
• Manage intercompany postings, allocations, invoicing, reconciliations, and eliminations.
• Ensure alignment with transfer pricing policies and support related documentation requirements.
• Prepare audit schedules and support quarterly reviews and annual audits.
• Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, SOX, internal controls, and company accounting policies.
• Maintain and improve process and control documentation within assigned areas.
• Develop, refine, and implement accounting procedures to improve efficiency, accuracy, and automation.
• Provide accounting guidance and support to project managers, operations teams, and other business partners.
• Perform ad hoc financial analysis and reporting as requested by management.
• Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for assigned areas.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance is required; CPA, CA, or Master’s degree in related field strongly preferred.
• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in U.S. GAAP consolidation, reporting, and corporate accounting.
• Experience in a multinational corporation and strong understanding of complex accounting and consolidation issues are required.
• Hands-on expertise with SAP BPC is required.
• Proficiency in SAP (ECC 6.0 and/or S4) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
• High degree of accuracy and attention to detail, with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of interacting effectively with all levels of management
• Ability to plan, organize, prioritize, and meet deadlines in a global, fast-paced, and performance driven environment.
• Adaptable, self-directed, and able to thrive in a rapidly changing environment.
• Previous management experience is required.

Company Description CMRS & Associates LLP (formerly Chandrakant G. Doshi & Co.) is a Chartered Accountancy firm with over 50 years of audit and advisory experience, serving diverse industry needs under one roof. The firm provides comprehensive services in taxation, accounting, auditing, and consulting, including Income Tax, GST, Sales Tax, Service Tax, and statutory audits.

In addition to conventional practice areas, CMRS & Associates LLP focuses on MSMEs, internal audits, and specialized audits aligned with current regulatory and business requirements. Over the years, the firm has built a trusted client base across multiple sectors, offering practical, compliance-focused, and growth-oriented solutions. Professionals joining the firm can expect exposure to varied industries and complex financial engagements.

Role Description The Chartered Accountant / Virtual CFO (VCFO) will work full time on-site in the Pune Division, providing end-to-end financial, accounting, and advisory support to clients. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing statutory and tax audits, reviewing financial statements, overseeing bookkeeping and compliance with Income Tax, GST, and other applicable regulations, and preparing reports and working papers. The role involves acting as a strategic finance partner to clients by supporting budgeting, cash flow planning, MIS reporting, and financial analysis for decision-making.

The professional will coordinate with client management teams, address audit queries, and ensure timely filings, documentation, and regulatory adherence. The role also includes mentoring junior team members, maintaining professional standards, and contributing to process improvements within the firm.

Qualifications

Professional qualification as a Chartered Accountant (CA) with strong knowledge of Indian accounting standards and financial reporting.

Experience in statutory audit, internal audit, and tax audit, including preparation and review of working papers and audit documentation.

Expertise in direct and indirect taxation (Income Tax, GST, Sales Tax, Service Tax), tax planning, and compliance with relevant laws and regulations.

Hands-on skills in accounting, finalization of accounts, and use of accounting software/ERP systems; strong MS Excel and report preparation capabilities.

Ability to function as a Virtual CFO, including budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, MIS generation, and financial analysis for business decisions.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk assessment skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in financial data.

Effective communication and interpersonal skills for working with client leadership and internal teams, including the ability to explain complex financial matters in clear terms.

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple engagements, meet deadlines, and work in an on-site professional environment in the Pune Division.

Prior experience with MSMEs and exposure to diverse industry sectors is an advantage.

Tasks

Objective:

To manage Monthly, half yearly and annual Closing of Books of accounts, Reporting as per Ind AS and IFRS, co-ordinate with Statutory, Regulators and Internal Audits, submission of various regulatory returns applicable, Monitoring Internal Control systems, ICOFR and Reconciliations.

A. Preparation of financial statements

1. To prepare & Review the Balance sheet, Profit & Loss statements, and schedules under IFRS for month end closure.

2. Review the inputs into the monthly reporting tool and ensure smooth closure of monthly reporting.

3. To prepare financial statements as per IND AS for regulatory reporting.

4. To maintain chart of accounts as per the headquarters guidelines

B. Regulatory Compliance:

1. To prepare various regulatory statutory returns on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, half yearly and on annual basis and submit the same with the regulator on a timely manner.

2. To ensure that the other regulatory certification and declaration such as FDI Certificate, Statutory Auditor’s Certificate are filed with the regulator’s on a timely basis.

3. To support in preparation of data for RBI related queries and Information sought from accounting.

4. To support the Regulator’s inspection from accounting and reporting standpoint.

5. Preparation of Liquidity Coverage Ratios & CRAR on monthly basis.

6. To prepare input for disclosures of various statutory financial and related information on the website of the Company on a timely manner.

7. To prepare and facilitate various regulatory reports for ALCO meetings.

8. To ensure all the relevant and applicable compliances are complied with and closed on a timely manner in the Compliance tool.

C. Audit:

1. To prepare the required balance sheet & P&L schedules as required during the Statutory audit.

2. To work closely with auditors and ensure that the financials contain all relevant disclosures applicable to the Company.

3. To review the audit observations and Management Letter and take it to the relevant team for response and closure.

4. To monitor and ensure the Internal Control Systems are in place as per the Mercedes- Benz Guidelines.

5. To ensure that the Internal Control on Financial Reporting are in place by demonstrating and documenting the controls in place.

6. To prepare presentations for various meetings related to audits like audit committee and board.

D. Accounting Reconciliations:

1. To review the statutory remittances carried out by Taxation and HR department and provide accounting clearance and facilitate nil / insignificant open items.

2. To review the inter-co accounting and confirmation process of all the inter-companies and ensure timely reporting with nil or identified reconciliation items.

3. To review and approve the daily clearing entries.

4. To ensure closure of BRS open items related to accounting.

5. To review and approve daily WFS ( wholesale system) interface reconciliations.

6. To ensure resolution of errors in WFS batch file.

7. To recommend for accounting approvals from CAO in special cases related to accounting.

8. To prepare wholesale system reconciliation.

9. To prepare workings and raise the invoices to intercompany for various transactions.

10. Reconciliation of TDS related to dealers.

11. To prepare the dealer balances confirmation and ensure that the same is received on time in coordination with wholesale team.

E. Liaison with Shared Service Centre and Treasury Centre and other support activities:

1. To closely work with the SSC team for ensuring proper, quality and timely submission of financials with HQ.

2. To review the performance of SSC and validate the head count justification.

3. To train and educate the SSC to comply with both the IFRS and Ind AS Accounting Standards.

4. To liaison with Treasury Centre of India (TCI) for various day to day and operation topics.

5. To provide various accounting and financial related inputs to TCI for getting the Credit Rating letters.

6. To work closely with TCI in monitoring the cash flow position of the Company and facilitate them with the latest ALM and LCR submission to take meaning decisions.

7. To support other functions of the Company as and when the demand arises.

F. To automate the various manual process to ensure accuracy and increase efficiency.

Role Overview:
As the Manager, you will be responsible for managing and supervising all finance and accounts functions to ensure the proper maintenance of accounting systems within the Company. You will play a crucial role in assisting the management with strategic and tactical matters related to Accounts Payable Function, cost-benefit analysis, audits, cash flow management, MIS reporting, and taxation. Your adaptability to a continually evolving environment while effectively managing the team will be key to your success.

Key Responsibilities:
- Oversee and Manage Accounts Payable: You will be accountable for the entire Accounts Payable process, from invoice processing to payment execution, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
- Manage the AP Team: Supervise, train, and evaluate team members, handle hiring and onboarding, to ensure the team's efficiency and effectiveness.
- Invoice and Payment Processing: Ensure all invoices are accurately recorded and paid on time, manage payment methods, and reconcile accounts.
- Vendor Management: Build and maintain relationships with suppliers, negotiate payment terms, and resolve any vendor-related issues.
- Compliance and Reporting: Ensure adherence to company policies, accounting standards, regulatory requirements, and prepare accurate financial reports. Check all other work related to accounts payable processing, TDS (26Q) filing, TRACES default correction/adjustment.
- Process Improvement: Identify areas for improvement in the AP process and implement changes to streamline operations and enhance efficiency.
- Cash Flow Management: Optimize cash flow by managing payment timing and ensuring the efficient use of company funds.
- Month-End and Year-End Closing: Coordinate and assist with the closing of accounting periods and check Bank Reconciliation on a monthly basis as per the bank-prescribed format with ERP.

Qualifications Required:
- Extremely strong fundamentals in accounting and reporting.
- Experience with ERP software (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics (D365)).
- Excellent multi-tasking skills.
- Good written & oral communication skills.
- Proactive and entrepreneurial traits with a willingness to grow and learn on a daily basis.
- Eye for detail.
- Good interpersonal skills.

Additional Company Details:
The compensation structure for this position will be as per industry standards.
